incident-bot: ALERT: High error rate for tenant marinerpay in dedicated-pool-3 — 5xx spikes, missing traces and partial metrics (pager: oncall@sre). Severity: P1.
SRE Oncall - Sara: jumping in. paging details?
incident-bot: Trigger: rate > 5% for 15m on route /v1/generate (dedicated-pool-3). Traces missing: 90% of spans for tenant_id=marinerpay. Logs show partial ingestion.
MarinerPay Support: we're seeing client errors and timeouts for some calls. Customer impact: commerce checkout timeouts, some retries. They've re-routed jobs to a fallback region temporarily.
Miguel (Infra): initial look — KV cache hits fine, but trace-forwarder for that tenant is returning 403 from the per-tenant forwarder role when contacting observability-proxy. suspect role/token rotation hit.
Jamie (DevOps): rolling a quick check of forwarder health. ps output from the forwarder pod:
```
NAME                         READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE
forwarder-marinerpay-0       2/2     Running   0          3d
forwarder-marinerpay-1       2/2     Running   5          7d
```
logs show repeated 403s: `POST /api/spans 403 service="obs-proxy" tenant=marinerpay`
SRE Oncall - Sara: copy. Miguel can you validate token expiry and the IAM role mapping? If it's rotated we need short-term bypass.
Miguel (Infra): checking KMS/HSM rotation logs — no recent full rotation, but I see a failed staged commit for marinerpay-forwarder-role at 2024-06-25T02:11:23Z. The commit aborted due to a policy gate. Forwarder attempted to use old token which was disabled by a safety policy.
SRE Oncall - Sara: that would explain 403 only for traces/logs, not the serving runtime. Is the serving runtime in same tenant pool?
Jamie (DevOps): serving runtime unaffected — requests still served by dedicated-pool-3; only observability egress path uses the forwarder role. We still have metrics shard for that tenant partially available; some metrics are partitioned to a different ingestion shard and are okay.
SRE Oncall - Sara: action plan: 1) temporary mitigation: re-enable the previous staging token for forwarder to restore observability to MarinerPay (low risk short window). 2) followup: fix the staged commit pipeline and add extra guardrail to prevent policy gating during token rollover. 3) customer comms.
Luke (Support): customer facing note draft: "We're investigating partial observability for your account impacting traces and logs. Your inference traffic is still running; we're prioritizing restoring full telemetry so we can debug errors." Want me to send?
Emma (Product): pls include ETA and that we will follow up with RCA. Customer is asking for root cause and mitigation timeline.
Miguel (Infra): re-enable procedure in progress: running the emergency token restore script with explicit approval. snippet:
```
./restore-token.sh --tenant marinerpay --token-id staging-20240625 --approve
```
Output: `restored token staging-20240625 -> active (grace 300s)`
incident-bot: NOTE: Emergency change logged: change-id=chg_20240625_4523, approver=SRE Oncall - Sara.
SRE Oncall - Sara: token restored. forwarder logs now show 200s for POST /api/spans. Confirming trace ingestion backlog draining.
Jamie (DevOps): metrics: shard replay kicked off for missing partitions. progress: 12% -> 38% in last 4m.
MarinerPay Support: thanks. Customer wants guaranteed avoidance of future blackouts during token re-roll — they asked about a secondary forwarder credential.
Miguel (Infra): long-term: implement dual-token handshake (active+standby) for forwarders + preflight policy check in rotation pipeline. I'll open a ticket. Change id: INFRA-3472.
SRE Oncall - Sara: handoff to Miguel for remediation and to Luke/Emma for customer comms. I'll leave oncall after 30m monitoring. anyone else picking oncall?
Jamie (DevOps): I'll stay on watch for 1hr to watch replay and latency.
Luke (Support): I'll send the customer update (ETA 2h for full replay, immediate telemetry restored). Drafting now.
Emma (Product): schedule follow-up call with MarinerPay for 08:00 PST to run through mitigation and roadmap for dual-token.
SRE Oncall - Sara: closing loop — current status: serving unaffected, observability restored via emergency token, replay in progress, customer notified. Postmortem and permanent mitigation owners: Miguel (Infra) and Jamie (DevOps).
MarinerPay Support: confirmed on their end — traces are appearing, they can see request-level spans. Thank you. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: status=mitigated, severity=P1->P2, notes="observability restored; replay ongoing; remediation ticket INFRA-3472"
SRE Oncall - Sara: logging this for RCA. Will collect timeline and will create postmortem doc. tagging: @Miguel (Infra) @Jamie (DevOps) @Luke (Support).
Miguel (Infra): ACK. I'll start the RCA draft and link logs/traces.
Jamie (DevOps): will include config snippets and the replay dashboard for the PM.
Luke (Support): leaving customer comms in sent items.
SRE Oncall - Sara: handing off; I'm signing off oncall now but monitoring until 172. Backups noted.
incident-bot: Auto-close reminder in 24h unless upgraded.
